title: sports.teams
description: Team directory for a league, alphabetised by display name. League must be one of the supported ids (see sports.leagues); an unknown league returns MeshDeny: sports_unknown_league. Cached ~24h.

league.description: League id (case-insensitive, normalised to lowercase by the handler). One of the ids returned by sports.leagues, e.g. 'nba', 'epl', 'worldcup'.
